subject: Pilot success plan & ownership — Orchid Labs pilot kickoff
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@orchidlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + pilot scope recap (Orchid Labs)

Thanks for the time today, Daniel — great conversation. Quick recap from our discovery so we can align the pilot scope and owners.

Summary (raw):
- Business goal: reduce latency and cost for Orchid's document ingestion pipeline while preserving extract quality for entity extraction and semantic search.
- Primary success metric: 95th percentile generation latency <= 250ms for short queries (<= 128 tokens) and end-to-end ingestion throughput >= 250 docs/minute.
- Quality guardrail: entity extraction F1 >= 0.88 on sample set (we agreed to provide 500 labeled examples).
- Security: data residency in us-west, logs retained for 30 days; SOC2 attestation required pre-production.

Proposed pilot plan (4 weeks):
1) Week 0 (this week): finalize connectivity + SSO/KMS requirements (Monica owner)
2) Week 1: baseline run on Orchid test set (Rishi + Marissa)
3) Week 2: tuning (batching, KV caching) and quantization experiments (Marissa owner)
4) Week 3: acceptance run, handoff to Eng for production checklist (Ben + Orchid eng)

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Daniel: send the 500 labeled examples and network allowlist (target: EOD Fri).
- Procurement: share standard PO terms or procurement contact (CC'd if applicable).
- Monica: I attached a light onboarding playbook and network requirements — please confirm.

Thanks — I'll set up a calendar hold for the kickoff next Tues.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-onboarding-playbook.pdf, network-requirements.xlsx

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@orchidlabs.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@orchid.io>, procurement@orchidlabs.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + pilot scope recap (Orchid Labs)

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the concise plan. Quick clarifications and a couple of asks from our side: 

Clarifications:
- The F1 target (0.88) looks reasonable; we will validate against the 500 examples.
- For latency: our user flows include some bursty periods — can the baseline include a 5-minute burst test at 2x expected load?

Asks:
- Sending labeled set now (drive link below).
- Procurement: please send a one-page commercial guide (pricing for 4-week pilot + optional Dedicated estimate). Procurement contact is sara@orchidlabs.com (cc'd via group address).
- Security: we require an audit statement on data handling (SOC2 + logging behavior) before full ingestion; is there a short template you can provide?

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=orchid-500-labeled

I'll confirm the kickoff calendar once we have SSO notes from Monica.

—Daniel
Head of Data Products
Orchid Labs

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@orchidlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, procurement@orchidlabs.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 12:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + pilot scope recap (Orchid Labs)

Perfect — thanks for the labeled set link, Daniel. Short follow-up: I put together a clear acceptance checklist and a recommended evaluation plan so we can objectively sign off at the end of Week 3. See highlights below and attached YAML reference.

Acceptance checklist (proposed):
- Performance: 95th pctl latency <= 250ms (128 token queries) and sustained throughput >= 250 docs/min during steady-state.
- Burst resilience: 5-min window at 2x load with no more than 2% request errors.
- Quality: entity extraction F1 >= 0.88 across the 500-example set.
- Security: SOC2 + signed data handling attestation; network allowlist in place.
- Ops handoff: runbook + alerting configured and validated with Orchid eng.

Evaluation plan (who does what):
- Data ingestion & baseline runs: Marissa (Redwood) + Orchid eng (Liam) — Week 1.
- Tuning experiments: Marissa — Week 2 (document wins/losses as comments).
- Acceptance run & report: Rishi + Marissa — Week 3.

Owners & quick commitments:
- Monica: finalize SSO & KMS integration checklist by Mon (5 Jul).
- Daniel/Liam: confirm availability for Week 1 baseline slots (Mon/Tue windows).
- Procurement: send PO guidance (Sara) — target Aug 1 for any pilot-to-paid conversion terms.

Attached: orchid-success-metrics.yaml (structured acceptance criteria) — small file.

I'll open a shared runbook in Drive and invite the stated owners. Ben, any notes on production handoff requirements you'd add early?

Thanks,
Rishi

Attachments: orchid-success-metrics.yaml

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@orchidlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + pilot scope recap (Orchid Labs)

Quick note from an infra/handoff perspective — a couple of practical items to unblock the Week 1 baseline: 

1) Please confirm IP allowlist and any proxying specifics (Monica, see network sheet). If Orchid uses NAT, we need the outbound ranges.
2) If Orchid wants to try a lower-precision quantized model for cost testing, we'll need a signed engagement doc (one-pager) to enable quantization on a dedicated test instance — I'll draft it and attach.
3) Ops alerting: recommend we add an error-rate Slack alert for >1% sustained errors over 5 minutes (fine-tune later).

I'm attaching a short checklist (network-requirements.xlsx) and a quantization consent one-pager stub. Happy to join the baseline run if you want a quick 30-min slot for the ingestion plumbing.

—Ben
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: network-requirements.xlsx, quantization-consent.pdf
